subject: Change order: phased SOW sequencing, billing and capacity add — BrightBridge
messages:
From: Andy Wilson <andy.wilson@brightbridge.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightbridge.com
Date: 2028-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: phased delivery + billing change order for BrightBridge

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. We have a pragmatic ask that will help align implementation with our fiscal planning: can Redwood produce a change order that phases the Statement of Work (Exhibit A) into three tranches (Q2 pilot, Q3 scale, Q4 full capacity) and aligns billing to those tranches (pro-rated fees on ramp)?

Key asks: 
- Add 480 GPU-hours/month for Q3 and 1,920 GPU-hours/month for Q4 (in Exhibit A).
- Re-sequence the SOW so pilot work (integration + analytics) is delivered and accepted before scale-phase fees commence.
- Add a billing proration clause for mid-quarter activations and clarify invoicing cadence.

I've attached our phase plan (BB_PhasePlan_Q2-Q4.xlsx) and a marked-up Exhibit A (SOW_ExhibitA_v2_redline.docx) for reference. Can your team draft a change order (redline preferred) and flag any procurement/legal items we should expect? Hope to have a signed CO by mid-April so our Q3 budget can process.

Appreciate your help — please let me know if you prefer a quick call to walk through the phases.

Best,
Andy
Andy Wilson
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightBridge Health
andy.wilson@brightbridge.com
(415) 555-0199

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Andy Wilson <andy.wilson@brightbridge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased delivery + billing change order for BrightBridge

Andy — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments, this is helpful. We can absolutely do a phased CO; I attached an initial draft (ChangeOrder_Draft_v0.1.docx) with the following high-level approach: 

1) Three tranches in Exhibit A matching your phase plan with explicit acceptance criteria for each tranche (integration smoke tests for pilot; throughput and latency targets for scale).
2) Proration language: if a tranche is activated mid-invoicing period, fees for that tranche will be pro-rated by active days and invoiced on the next cycle.
3) SLA trigger for surge/burst capacity: any usage above committed hours will be billed at the overage rate in the Order Form; we added a 30-day notice path for temporary bursts.

As requested, looping in Karthik (legal procurement) and Marissa (CS implementation) to review the redlines and confirm there are no blockers on SLA or billing mechanics. Karthik — primary legal asks: confirm whether the proration language as written (daily pro-rate) is acceptable or if we should default to monthly tiers; also confirm effective date mechanics.

Andy — if you're comfortable with the approach, can BrightBridge confirm the PO path and target signatory? Once we have legal concurrence I'll circulate the redline for signature (DocuSign).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Strategic Account Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
(415) 555-0222

Attachment: ChangeOrder_Draft_v0.1.docx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-02T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased delivery + billing change order for BrightBridge — legal notes

Lauren / Marissa — quick legal read below. I captured the items we need to tighten before sending the CO final: 

• Effective date vs billing start: avoid ambiguous "activation" language. Propose: billing for tranche N begins on the later of (a) acceptance of tranche N by BrightBridge per the acceptance criteria, or (b) 14 days after Redwood notifies BrightBridge that resources are provisioned.

• Proration: daily prorate is OK but add a cap so we don't do micro-invoicing (minimum invoicing increment = 7 days).

• SLA and credits: acceptance criteria should be objective tests with pass/fail buckets. Credits for SLA misses should be limited and subject to a claims process within 30 days of the invoice.

• Audit / usage evidence: add explicit reference to tokenized usage logs and a joint review window (30 days) for disputed usage before any billing adjustments.

• Term / renewal interplay: if the customer accelerates to Q4 full capacity early, clarify whether the ramped fees replace or supplement the committed baseline fees (I recommend replacement with a one-time reconciliation invoice).

I'll attach redline_notes.txt with suggested language snippets. Once we agree I can merge into Lauren's draft and push to DocuSign.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracting & Procurement
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: redline_notes.txt

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Andy Wilson <andy.wilson@brightbridge.com>, procurement@brightbridge.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased delivery + billing change order for BrightBridge — draft ready for signature

Andy / procurement team — following internal review we've incorporated Karthik's notes and Marissa's implementation acceptance language. Summary of changes since your redline: 

- Explicit acceptance criteria for each tranche included in Exhibit A (integration checklist, throughput/latency test cases).
- Billing start rules: billing for a tranche begins on the later of acceptance or 14 days after provisioning. Daily proration allowed but minimum invoice increment is 7 days.
- SLA credits and dispute window added (30 days for usage disputes).
- If BrightBridge accelerates to full capacity early, fees will replace baseline commitments and a one-time reconciliation invoice will be issued.

I've published the final change order to DocuSign here: https://docusign.com/BRB-CO-1143 (ChangeOrder_Final.pdf attached). Please confirm the PO number and signatory name so we can send the envelope to the correct person. If you want one more live review, I'm available for a 20-minute call today.

Next steps once signed: Redwood will provision Q3 capacity within 5 business days of the Signature Date and schedule the pilot acceptance window per Exhibit A.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Strategic Account Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
(415) 555-0222

Attachment: ChangeOrder_Final.pdf
